component: Recovery Time Objective (RTO) & Recovery Point Objective (RPO)

rto_measurements.operation: Secure Emergency Read Reconstruction (4 MiB, 8 shards lost)

rpo_guarantees.committed_manifest_watermark: Zero data loss for all committed transactions durably flushed to WAL snapshot before disaster
rpo_guarantees.uncommitted_mutations: In-flight uncommitted writes fail closed and are discarded upon incarnation transition
rpo_guarantees.fencing_guarantee: Superseded incarnations strictly prevented from mutating storage nodes, guaranteeing zero post-disaster divergence
